header.headline: Licenses
header.subhead: What is open, under which license, and what remains proprietary.

sections.title: Open-source components
sections.body: The landing repository (meviza/sibernetick-landing) — pages, components, styles, content schema, and documentation — is dual-licensed.
sections.body2: Choose one license when you use the code. MIT suits minimal headers; Apache-2.0 adds an express patent grant and NOTICE obligations. Full texts are in the repository.

sections.title: Proprietary components
sections.body: The Sibernetick product application, agent runtime, orchestration engine, detection logic, rulesets, and lab datasets are not open source. They are provided under a commercial agreement only.

sections.title: Third-party licenses
sections.body: Dependencies pulled in by the landing repository keep their own licenses; their notices ship with the repository. Where a dependency is Apache-2.0, its NOTICE and attribution requirements are preserved.

sections.title: Trademarks
sections.body: The MIT and Apache grants do not cover the Sibernetick name, logo, or branding. Use of marks requires permission; open-source use of the code does not imply endorsement.

sections.title: Commercial licensing
sections.body: Need a different license for the product, an OEM arrangement, or a co-branded deployment? Contact us.
